integrity: The proof is analytic once the primary source's weight formulas and characteristic polynomial are accepted. The packaged checker is a finite sanity check only and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the regular twelve-vertex pure-rotational-tetrahedral orbit family and its three normalized edge-orbit weights; no claim is made for arbitrary vertex-transitive polytopes or collapsed boundary orbits.
title: Sharp quadratic spectral stability for tetrahedral orbit polytopes
